items.text: refund chahiye
item return karna hai
kab milega
jaldi chahiye

items.context: Kya aapne item deliver kar liya hai?
items.text: theek hai

items.context: Kya aapka address confirm karna hai?
items.text: address confirm karo
mera order mujhe galat item mila hai
main apna item wapas bhejna chahta hoon
kya aap mujhe refund process bata sakte ho
maine item kal receive kiya tha par damaged tha
refund kab tak milega please batayein
return pickup kaise arrange karwana hoga
order cancel karna hai toh kya karna padega

items.context: Kya aapka item abhi tak deliver hua hai?
items.text: haan mera item delivery ho chuka hai

items.context: Kahan par aapko refund milega chahiye?
items.text: refund amount mere bank account mein chahiye

items.context: Kya aap ke paas order number hai?
items.text: main order number batata hoon ek minute

items.context: Kya reason hai aapke return ka?
items.text: item defective tha isliye return karna hai
pickup kab hoga mujhe inform kar dena
maine apna order receipt ke baad check kiya to item broken nikla
refund lene ke liye mujhe kya documents dene honge aur process kya hai
main apni taraf se pura try kar raha hoon lekin refund thoda time leta hai
main kal apna parcel wapas karne wala hoon lekin mujhe pickup details nahi mili
maine 3 din ho gaye return request kiye lekin abhi tak refund nahi mila
kya main kisi aur payment method mein refund le sakta hoon jaise digital wallet
agar item return nahi hua toh mera paisa kab tak refund hoga

items.context: Kya aap item receive kar chuke hain aur return karna chahenge?
items.text: haan maine delivery check kar liya hai lekin item sahi nahi tha aur main return karna chahta hoon

items.context: Aapko kis wajah se refund process ko lekar pareshani ho rahi hai?
items.text: refund process bahut time le raha hai mujhe jaldi paisa chahiye tha kyunki mujhe emergency mein chahiye tha

items.context: Pickup arrange karne mein aapko koi dikkat ho rahi hai kya?
items.text: mujhe pickup ke liye contact koi nahi kar raha hai aur ab parcel mere paas pad raha hai main confused hoon next step kya hoga

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: return_refund - wants to return an item or asks about a refund
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
